description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002067
DOCKET NO. F1026625
PLAINTIFF – GINA ADDEO
DEFENDANTS- BRYANT STINEY
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 21st DAY OF October 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of PLAINFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: BLOCK 936 LOT 1
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
733-743 RAVINE ROAD PLAINFIELD, NJ 07060
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Dimensions of lot (approximately): 150 x 125
Nearest cross Street: Dixie Lane
Estimated upset price: $665,069.38
Exhibit "A"
ALL that certain Lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the City of Plainfield,
County of Union, State of New Jersey, and being more particularly described as follows:
BEGINNING at a point formed by the intersection of the easterly line of Ravine Road
(50-foot right-of-way) with the southerly line of Dixie Lane (50-foot right-of-way) and running; thence
(1 ) Along the easterly line of Ravine Road with an unknown radius, a chord bearing and distance of South 26 degrees 52 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 12.59 feet to a point; thence
(2) Still along said easterly line of Ravine Road with an unknown radius, a chord bearing and distance of South 12 degrees 38 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 75.14 feet to a point; thence
(3) Still along said easterly line of Ravine Road with an unknown radius, a chord bearing and
distance of South 4 degrees 88 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 37.18 feet to a
point; thence
(4) North 87 degrees 30 minutes 00 seconds East, 149.80 feet to a point; thence
(5) North 00 degrees 38 minutes 00 seconds West* 4.33 feet to a point; thence
(6) North 00 degrees 20 minutes 24 seconds West 1 16.25 feet to the said southerly line of
Dixie Lane and a point; thence
(7) Along the said southerly line of Dixie Lane, South 87 Degrees 30 minutes 00 seconds East, 125.69 feet to said easterly line of Ravine Road and the point and Place of BEGINNING.
The above description is written in accordance with a survey prepared by William Held Associates, Inc., dated April 18, 2016.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHE
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $672,789.07 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: September 21, 2026
LAW OFFICES OF DARIN D. PINTO, P.C.
376 SOUTH AVENUE
WESTFIELD, NJ 07090
